subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical activity/progress contract should the Control UI consume for active runs: the broader gateway sessions.activity contract, a narrower Control UI-only projection, or a staged coarse-status path first?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix defines public session activity semantics and needs maintainer agreement before another implementation branch should be queued.

options.title: Align with gateway activity contract
options.body: Define the gateway-owned activity/attention schema and have the Control UI render a compact strip from that source of truth.

options.title: Stage a narrower UI projection
options.body: Allow a smaller Control UI status strip using existing hasActiveRun and tool activity while explicitly tracking the missing backend contract as follow-up.

options.title: Pause behind existing PRs
options.body: Do not start new work until maintainers decide whether the open activity-stream or blocked/stale-status PRs should be adopted, narrowed, or closed.

recommendation.title: Align with gateway activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the gateway-owned activity/attention schema and have the Control UI render a compact strip from that source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical broader gateway activity issue and is the best available owner for the public API direction decision.
